# HOP DONG BAO HIEM TAI SAN

## (BAO HIEM MOI RUI RO TAI SAN)

TEN TO CHUC (BEN A)  CONG TY CO PHAN XUAT NHAP KHAU HUONG GIANG

DIA CHI  214 LE LOI

MA SO THUE  4369368329

DIEN THOAI  0976152750

TEN TO CHUC (BEN B)  CONG TY CP BAO HIEM NHAN THO THAI DUONG

DIA CHI  SO 42 TRAN DUY HUNG, MAY CHAI, NGO QUYEN, HAI PHONG

DIEN THOAI  0339066797

NHA KHO VA VAN PHONG  16,000,000,000

KHO LANH VA THIET BI BAO QUAN  4,500,000,000

TONG CONG  20,500,000,000

1) BEN B BOI THUONG CHO NHUNG TON THAT VAT CHAT BAT NGO VA KHONG LUONG TRUOC DUOC XAY RA DOI VOI TAI SAN

DUOC BAO HIEM, TRU CAC TRUONG HOP LOAI TRU TRACH NHIEM BAO HIEM QUY DINH TAI QUY TAC BAO HIEM MOI RUI RO

TAI SAN DINH KEM.

2) MUC KHAU TRU: 50.000.000 DONG CHO MOI VA MOI VU TON THAT. PHI BAO HIEM THANH TOAN MOT LAN BANG CHUYEN

KHOAN TRONG VONG 20 NGAY KE TU NGAY KY HOP DONG.

3) BEN A CO TRACH NHIEM KE KHAI DAY DU, TRUNG THUC; AP DUNG CAC BIEN PHAP DE PHONG, HAN CHE TON THAT; KHI

XAY RA SU KIEN BAO HIEM, THONG BAO NGAY CHO BEN B TRONG VONG 24 GIO VA GIU NGUYEN HIEN TRUONG.

4) BEN B CAP GIAY CHUNG NHAN BAO HIEM SAU KHI BEN A DA DONG DU PHI; BOI THUONG TRONG VONG 15 NGAY KE TU

NGAY NHAN DU HO SO HOP LE.

5) MOI TRANH CHAP TRUOC HET GIAI QUYET BANG THUONG LUONG; KHONG THUONG LUONG DUOC THI DUA RA TOA AN

CO THAM QUYEN TAI VIET NAM.

DAI DIEN BEN A  DAI DIEN BEN B

(KY, GHI RO HO TEN VA DONG  (KY, GHI RO HO TEN VA DONG

DAU)  DAU)

CONG TY CHI CHI TRA SAU KHI DOI CHIEU CHU KY VOI HO SO YEU CAU BAO HIEM
